annotations.title: Tax on profit paid from Poland to another country

description: Use for tax on dividends, interest or royalties paid abroad. Also use for the countries that invest the most in Poland (NBP data). Give the legal basis and the verification date of each fact. Polish withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties paid to a resident of a country: the statutory rate, the rate in the double tax treaty with Poland (portfolio and qualified holding), whether MLI modifies the treaty, and the EU/EEA/Swiss parent-subsidiary exemption with its holding conditions. Covers the largest investor countries by NBP data; without country returns the list and the ranking.
